question:
Select the most appropriate homonym to fill in the blank.

These products _______ for a long time.
solution:
The correct answer is** 'last'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"last"** primarily can be an adjective, a verb, or a noun In.
 
• In the given context, it is** used as a verb.**
 
• As a verb, "last" means to continue in time, to go on in existence for a long duration without giving out or decaying **(लंबे समय तक अस्तित्व में बने रहना I)**.
 
 
• For example, "These heavy-duty batteries can **last** for several years."
 
 
 
• Here, the verb "last" fits perfectly because the sentence talks about the longevity or duration of time the products continue to function or exist.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2. **

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• ** Lust:** A passionate desire for something.** (किसी चीज़ की तीव्र इच्छा।)**
 
• ** Lost**: Unable to be found or recovered ** (लुप्त)**
 
• **Least**: Smallest in amount, degree, or size.** (कम से कम)**
